brief:
Benjamin Netanyahu retains the prime minister's office as Israel's reconstituted parliament convenes Tuesday, but the incoming legislature's altered composition poses significant obstacles to his political agenda, according to Al-Monitor. The shift in parliamentary alignment signals reduced backing for Netanyahu within the governing body, complicating his ability to advance initiatives and maintain legislative support.

The new parliament's less favorable makeup could constrain Netanyahu's maneuverability on policy matters and force him to navigate more challenging political dynamics than previously faced.
dek: Benjamin Netanyahu remains Israel's prime minister when the new parliament takes office Tuesday but its new, less friendly composition could make his life much more difficult.
title: Israel's new parliament threatens Netanyahu's political position
